raw_text:
Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md).
Review domain module documentation before changes.
Use module owners (or the platform team) for cross-cutting approvals.
Record architecture decisions in `DECISIONS/` using an ADR.
Do not create a new document when an existing one is suitable — extend it instead.
Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code.
Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures.
Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested.
Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.
Ownership: platform `crates/rustok-core`, `apps/server`, shared infra; domains `crates/rustok-*`; frontends `apps/admin`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/next-admin`, `apps/next-frontend`; MCP `crates/rustok-mcp`; tooling `scripts/`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `grafana/`, `prometheus/`. See [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md).
Docs: central `docs/` Russian; public contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, crate `README.md` English. Mixed language within a single document is not allowed — choose one language per file. Platform docs `docs/`; component docs `apps/<name>/docs/`.
